standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion for R-universality through the Tits algebras being split

standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the triviality of the star-action into the conclusion that every Tits algebra is Q itself, hence the algebra is R-universal.

core_obligations: Trivial star-action: for types E8, F4 and G2 there are no outer automorphisms, so the star-action must be trivial, and these groups also have trivial centre (proof lines 507-509).
Apply the author's remark: it is then immediate from the author's remark labelled OnlyZStar that the Tits algebra D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) is Q for every dominant weight lambda (proof lines 509-512).

Conclude R-universality: the divisional-algebra description of R-universality, the third item of the author's equivalence labelled RunivIff, then gives that the algebra is R-universal (proof line 512).
proof_roadmap: 这些类型没有外自同构且中心平凡，故 star 作用平凡。
由作者的 OnlyZStar 注记立即得到每个支配权的 Tits 代数都是 Q，再由 RunivIff 的除代数等价描述得到 R-universality。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the exhaustiveness of the exceptional types (author lemma at source lines 501-504, label EFGAllUniv): every absolutely simple Lie algebra of type E8, F4 or G2 over Q is R-universal. The proof (source lines 506-512) is short but it is the case that closes the author's classification, and it works precisely because these three types have no outer automorphisms and trivial centre, which makes the star-action trivial (proof lines 507-509); the author then reads off from the earlier remark on the root-lattice case that the Tits algebras are split and concludes with the division-algebra description of R-universality (proof lines 509-512). The author calls the remaining types very easy to deal with immediately before the statement, and the card keeps that level of detail. H2.
